_what: Where a message the person sends from the shared composer is kept (send-to-seeds.ts): one row of the owner's own seeds table (id, words, came_from, media, at, kept_at) in the database the owner-places record names for `role` (owner-place.ts). Every statement is a tool run (`tool`) with statement_timeout_ms. `route` is the device outbox's path for the message and `key_field` is the body field its client id travels in (share-outbox.ts). `insert` writes the row once: the id is composer:<client id>, so a send again with the same client id answers the row already held, never a second row. `sent_at` is what the person is told, with {time} the row's kept_at in the Mac's time.
insert: with ins as (insert into {table} (id, words, came_from, media, at, kept_at) values ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4::jsonb, $5::timestamptz, now()) on conflict (id) do nothing returning id, kept_at) select id, kept_at::text as kept_at from ins union all select id, kept_at::text as kept_at from {table} where id = $1 and not exists (select 1 from ins)
no_place: Your AIs have no place for messages on this account yet, so this message was not kept.
not_kept: The message was not kept: the account answered without its row.
